question: 連接法蘭目前在各倉庫各有多少庫存？
sql:
SELECT w.name AS 倉庫, s.status AS 狀態, SUM(s.qty) AS 數量
FROM stock s
JOIN parts p ON p.part_id = s.part_id
JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%法蘭%'
GROUP BY w.name, s.status
ORDER BY 數量 DESC;

question: 哪些零件的可用庫存低於安全庫存？
sql:
SELECT name AS 品名, available AS 可用庫存, safety_stock AS 安全庫存, safety_stock - available AS 差額
FROM v_part_stock
WHERE available < safety_stock
ORDER BY 差額 DESC;

question: 目前有哪些保留中的庫存？保留給誰？
sql:
SELECT p.name AS 品名, w.name AS 倉庫, s.lot_no AS 批號, s.qty AS 數量, s.note AS 備註
FROM stock s
JOIN parts p ON p.part_id = s.part_id
JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id
WHERE s.status = '保留'
ORDER BY s.qty DESC;

question: 還沒出完貨的訂單有哪些？
sql:
SELECT o.so_no AS 訂單號, o.line_no AS 項次, o.customer AS 客戶, p.name AS 品名, o.qty - o.qty_shipped AS 未出貨, o.due_on AS 交期
FROM sales_orders o
JOIN parts p ON p.part_id = o.part_id
WHERE o.status != '已出貨'
ORDER BY o.due_on;

question: 九月每個零件各出貨了幾件？
sql:
SELECT p.name AS 品名, -SUM(m.qty) AS 出貨數量
FROM stock_moves m
JOIN parts p ON p.part_id = m.part_id
WHERE m.move_type = '銷貨出庫' AND m.moved_on BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY 出貨數量 DESC;

question: 還沒完工的工單各還差多少？
sql:
SELECT w.wo_no AS 工單號, p.name AS 品名, w.qty_planned - w.qty_done AS 未完工數量, w.status AS 狀態, w.due_on AS 預計完工日
FROM work_orders w
JOIN parts p ON p.part_id = w.part_id
WHERE w.status != '已完工'
ORDER BY w.due_on;

question: 目前庫存依標準成本計算總價值多少？
BRK-1001 最近 5 筆庫存異動
sql:
SELECT m.moved_on AS 日期, w.name AS 倉庫, m.move_type AS 類型, m.qty AS 數量, m.ref_no AS 單號
FROM stock_moves m
JOIN parts p ON p.part_id = m.part_id
JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = m.warehouse_id
WHERE p.part_no = 'BRK-1001'
ORDER BY m.move_id DESC
LIMIT 5;
